data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include favourable prior year development of GBP 42.8m (2017 adverse development: GBP 14.5m). Prior year claims development is analysed by line of business in the table below.

Notable prior year development referenced in the report; contributed materially to 2017 loss.

Noted as a material contributor to the 2017 loss and as an area of prior year development.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 gross claims outstanding were GBP 523.82m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net gross prior-year strengthening of c. GBP 17.5m (3.35% of opening reserves), driven by adverse movements in several older underwriting years offset in parts by releases in others. The managing agent describes the year as benign overall with favourable net prior-year development (net of reinsurance), notably on Political Risks & Political Violence, and limited impact from the 2018 hurricanes and wildfires. The gross strengthening contrasts with a reported net favourable prior-year development (net of reinsurance), indicating that increased reinsurance recoverables materially offset gross adverse movements.
raw_causal_phrases: element of favourable prior year development, notably on Political Risks & Political Violence

The decrease in the net loss ratio to 51.8% (2017: 67.2%) reflects a benign period of catastrophe events (compared to 2017 hurricane impact), with an element of favourable prior year development on attritional losses
The impact of the 2018 hurricanes and wildfires was marginal, being contained within planned loss ratios

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (see note). The report also states a net favourable prior year development of GBP 42.8m (net of reinsurance) in the P&L - this is NET and differs from the gross triangle-derived result, indicating material movements in reinsurer recoverables. Line-by-line prior year movements published in the P&L appear to be NET of reinsurance and have been used for LOB-level movements where no gross breakdown is available. Some event references are not individually named (e.g. '2018 hurricanes and wildfires'), and amounts for specific events are not quantified.
